objective: Add an exact isolated-gateway kill switch and prove controlled stop, restart, audit and recovery behavior before the first autonomous product task.
acceptanceCriteria: The operator can stop only the isolated Sanctuary engineering gateway by its protected PID, exact runtime user, process title and loopback port without broad process matching or a force-kill fallback.
A missing, stale, malformed, reused or unowned PID fails closed or is cleared only when the isolated gateway is already confirmed offline.
A clean stop preserves the default OpenClaw authority files, removes only the isolated PID record and leaves GitHub, Portal access and manual development untouched.
The isolated gateway can restart from the same reviewed state and its plugin and durable task audit return clean without creating a duplicate flow, lane or worker.
Deterministic tests cover timeout, CI failure, transient rerun, reviewer rejection, unsafe identity and restart recovery boundaries before live model work is promoted.
The live role-boundary rehearsal and first low-risk product proof remain blocked until the isolated supervisor credential succeeds through the gateway.
stopConditions: The PID, runtime user, process title, loopback port, default authority fingerprint or isolated state does not match exactly.
Stopping or recovery would require a broad process match, force kill, state deletion, duplicate flow, duplicate lane or second active worker.
A live model turn lacks the isolated supervisor credential or crosses the reviewed supervisor, worker or reviewer tool boundary.
The rehearsal would merge, deploy, access production, contact a customer or staff member, or expose a token or private task payload.
